meta.name: browser-cdp
meta.description: Use this skill when you need to control a Chrome browser via CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol) to reuse existing login sessions. Covers: launching Chrome in debug mode, opening URLs, waiting for page load, evaluating JavaScript, taking snapshots, and extracting auth tokens. Trigger phrases: browser automation, CDP, agent-browser, 浏览器操作, 操作浏览器, Chrome CDP, 复用登录态, extract token from browser.

copy.tagline: 用CDP协议控制Chrome浏览器，自动化执行页面操作与令牌提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要脚本化操作Chrome浏览器并复用已有登录态
copy.tagline_en: Control Chrome via CDP to automate browsing and extract auth tokens
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to script Chrome interactions while reusing existing login sessions

howto.what: 装上此技能后，Claude 可通过 CDP 协议控制 Chrome 浏览器，执行打开网址、等待加载、运行 JavaScript、提取页面文本和登录令牌、点击及输入等自动化操作，并复用已有的登录会话。
howto.when: 当你提到“浏览器自动化”、“CDP”、“agent-browser”、“浏览器操作”等关键词，或要求控制 Chrome 浏览器、复用登录态时触发。

say.text: 帮我打开百度并搜索天气
say.note: Claude 会用 CDP 打开页面并等待加载。

say.text: 从浏览器中提取登录 token
点击页面的登录按钮并输入用户名

howto.what_en: This skill enables Claude to control a Chrome browser via CDP, performing actions like opening URLs, waiting for page loads, evaluating JavaScript, extracting page text and auth tokens, clicking, and typing, while reusing existing login sessions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'browser automation', 'CDP', 'agent-browser', '浏览器操作', or ask to control Chrome or reuse login sessions.

say_en.text: Open Baidu and search for weather
say_en.note: Claude will open the page and wait for load using CDP.

say_en.text: Extract login token from the browser
say_en.note: Claude runs eval to read localStorage or cookies.

say_en.text: Click the login button and type username
say_en.note: Claude uses snapshot to locate elements, then clicks and types.
